authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Qualified members of the regional velā time/daylight family: Turner gives Assamese beli time, Oriya beḷa daytime and eastern ber/beri forms, while noting a probable Dravidian background with sun/daytime meanings. The surveys themselves attest the sun sense. This is a comparative family assignment with a daylight-to-sun semantic extension; regional contact and the exact transmission path remain open, especially in Hajong/Bishnupriya. Retroflex beṛ/beḍ forms are excluded because Turner also separates a *veḍā branch.
